meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 把一张多步流程(DAG)存成带名字的模板，之后直接叫名字就能跑，不用再贴整份定义；每次运行会自动加时间戳，默认开新一轮。它管的是“存起来、反复用”，不负责从零画新图。
howto.when: 当用户要求保存一个 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG，或反复调度同一张多智能体图时触发。

say.text: 保存刚才这张图为 nightly-audit。
say.note: 写入库目录并启动一次试运行确认。
键自动带上时间戳，开启全新一轮。

say.text: 安排 nightly-audit 每天执行一遍。
say.note: 外部调度器可复用这份定义反复运行。

howto.what_en: Stores a DAG definition once under a name, then reruns it by name without re-pasting. Every run gets a new timestamped key by default, so it starts fresh each time. This covers storage/rerun only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or repeatedly schedule the same multi-agent graph.

say_en.text: Save the current graph as nightly-audit.
say_en.note: Writes it to the library and does a test run.

say_en.text: Run the saved nightly-audit by name.
say_en.note: Starts a fresh run with a timestamped key.

say_en.text: Schedule nightly-audit to run every day.
say_en.note: Keeps the definition available for repeated scheduled use.
